subject: Money
title: Small Business Tax
description: A fast breakdown of Small Business Tax for builders.

hook.text: Amazon paid zero federal tax on $11.2 billion in profit in 2018. A local bakery can't do that.

buildup.text: Small businesses often pay through the owner's personal income tax. This is called pass-through taxation.

discovery.text: Pass-through income is taxed at personal rates up to 37%. Big corporations face 21%. The little guy pays more.

twist.text: The 2017 tax law added a 20% deduction for pass-through income, but with so many rules few can use it.

climax.text: Tax complexity itself is a tax. Small businesses spend more time and money complying than large corporations.

punchline.text: The tax code favors those who can afford lawyers.

quiz.question: What is pass-through taxation?
options: Business profit taxed on the owner's personal return
Tax paid when goods cross state lines
